title: Semolina and Sesame Grissini
summary: A semolina and plain flour dough with honey and olive oil is risen, cut into strips, rolled into ropes, brushed and rolled in sesame seeds, then baked until golden.
equipment: large bowl or stand mixer with dough hook
2 large baking trays lined with baking paper

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Knead the dough
steps.text: Combine the semolina, flour, yeast, salt and a spoonful of sesame, add the honeyed water and oil and knead until velvety.

steps.title: Prove
steps.text: Cover and leave 1.5-2 hours until well risen.

steps.title: Cut
steps.text: Press into a 30 x 20 cm rectangle and cut into 30 strips.

steps.title: Shape
steps.text: Roll each strip into a thin 28 cm rope.

steps.title: Coat
steps.text: Brush with the oil and water mixture and roll in sesame seeds.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake at 200 °C (180 °C fan) for 16-20 minutes until golden and crisp. Cool on the trays.

tips: The oil and water wash helps the seeds stick without egg.
Roll gently in the seeds so the ropes keep their shape.
Watch the last few minutes: sesame browns quickly.
storage: Store in an airtight tin at room temperature for up to 1 week. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
